definition: a place where people live, smaller than a town
description: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.
